summary.text: Abby Angelos is a Republican member of the Wyoming House of Representatives for District 3 who is not seeking re-election to that seat and is instead a candidate for Wyoming State Senate District 23 on November 3, 2026.
She has been a women's ministry director.

paragraphs.text: Abby Angelos was born in Buffalo, Wyoming, and graduated from Wright High School in 1998.
Ballotpedia lists her career experience as a women's ministry director.
Angelos assumed office in the Wyoming House on January 2, 2023, succeeding Eric Barlow.
For 2025-2026 she was vice chair of the Select Committee on School Facilities and was assigned to the House Appropriations Committee and the House Rules and Procedure Committee.
She advanced from the August 18, 2026 Republican primary for Senate District 23.
